selection_boundary: Models and parameters were frozen before any formal test-model call.
within_profile_fairness: B0, B1, B2, B4 and IPER-RAG share the same profile, task subset, seeds and budgets.
failure_policy: Provider, parsing and budget failures remain in the denominator and are reported by category.
test_policy: Run all 30 frozen test variations with seeds 11, 29 and 47; never select a model or task using formal outcomes.
